cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: V předmětu budou probírána jednotlivá dietární opatření a jejich pozitivní či negativní vlivy na organismus člověka. Předmět je zaměřen na skladbu jednotlivých diet používaných v klinické praxi i diet rozšířených v běžné populaci včetně jejich kladů a záporů.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course will discuss individual dietary measures and their positive or negative effects on the human body. The course is focused on the composition of individual diets used in clinical practice and diets widespread in the general population, including their pros and cons.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Basic recommendations of rational nutrition - creation, materials, division according to purpose (allowance 2/2)2.Organizations, programs and projects to support rational nutrition (allowance 2/2)3.Nutritional factors (allowance 4/4) a.Nutritional factors, their need and sources in foodb.Utilization of nutritional factors, deficit, excess4.Eating habits of the population (allowance 2/4) a.Factors that affect eating habitsb.Methods for determining eating habits5.Development of nutritional recommendations, history (allowance 2/0)6.Diets, definitions and divisions (allowance 6/6) a.Basic and standardized dietsb.Special diets, reduction dietsc.Effect of diets on physiological processes of the human body7.Dietary systems used in healthcare (allowance 4/4)8.Actual nutritional trends and alternative nutritional directions (allowance 2/2)
